verdict.rationale: Bento documents reusable email templates that update everywhere they are used, and its CLI lists "manage templates" among its commands. That suggests templates can be managed programmatically, though the evidence does not detail how. missing for 10: HTML/MJML authoring evidence, documented variable/Liquid substitution, a template API endpoint reference, an explicit version-control/templates-as-code workflow, and independent corroboration.
